name: program-runtime.failure-triage
purpose: Summarize recurring program failure shapes with ranked, shape-linked evidence and timestamps, without materializing the corpus.

include_operator.description: Include operator-provenance submissions in the mined corpus.

invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most 20 shape rows are read with head; no full materialization
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.returned_shapes: number of shape rows summarized, at most 20
signals.complete: whether all source rows and required evidence were available
signals.truncated: whether the 20-row summary bound omitted source rows
signals.by_shape: shape -> count (first 20 shapes; retained for existing consumers)
signals.shape_details: shape -> count, first_seen, last_seen, and sample_program_id
signals.top: the three most frequent returned shapes; only complete when status is ok
signals.evidence_by_shape: ranked shape -> sample program id, keyed so callers can inspect the matching failure

outputs.evidence: available sample program ids in top order, at most three; evidence_by_shape provides the authoritative shape association
